description_en: Queries the configurations of a domain name
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-ipa-domain-configs --domain-name example.com --function-names protogw --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnIpaDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 您的加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the feature. Set the value to protogw. protogw specifies IP application acceleration
parameters.help_zh: 功能列表名称。仅支持protogw，表示IP应用加速
parameters.name: function_names
